answers.mechanism: Homogenization adds a common factorial and preserves binomial cancellation; a multiplier leaves a boundary term. Two-pair contraction reduces by beta integration to neighboring coefficients controlled by endpoint contact.

answers.verification_obstacles: The explicit proofs are self-contained apart from the cited one-pair theorem establishing minimality. Long attribution needs the reference. Final reread resolves the post-multiplier selection ambiguity and confirms complete five-page pagination.
